jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionPlain:
ABOUT ACME ROBOTICS

Acme Robotics builds autonomous mobile robots for warehouses. The platform team runs the services that connect every robot to the cloud.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and operate the deployment pipeline for our Go services.
- Keep Terraform modules and AWS accounts tidy and secure.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect (AMER)
jobs.descriptionPlain: Acme Robotics builds autonomous mobile robots for warehouses. As a solutions architect you help customers in the Americas plan their first robot fleet.

jobs.title: Support Engineer (EMEA)
jobs.descriptionPlain: Acme Robotics builds autonomous mobile robots for warehouses. As a support engineer you keep customer fleets in Europe running.
